Rippling._comment: Bangalore, lunch and dinner sessions on ONE counter ('Counter 1'). Source: the client's requirement sheet (T1-T5) plus the earlier asks (north + south veg dry, chicken + egg on Wednesday, curd and raita apart, bread 1 plain chapati). Live row as of 16 Nov 2026: categories welcome_drink, soup, salad, bread, rice, white_rice, veg_dry, veg_gravy, dal, sambar_rasam, curd, curd_side, nonveg_main, dessert; slot_counts bread 2, veg_dry 2, nonveg_main 2; themes Mon/Tue mix, Wed biryani, Thu chinese, Fri north.
Rippling._disable_comment: curd_raita_logic picks curd-or-raita for the single curd_side slot; Rippling has two slots (curd = curd only, curd_side = raita only). nonveg_main_daily_pair wants a dry + a chicken gravy whenever 2+ non-veg slots exist; Rippling's rows are chicken daily and egg on Wednesday, which the rules below state instead.

rules._comment: 'North veg dry and south veg dry irrespective of the theme' (owner, 16 Nov). Bangalore's theme_cuisine_filter verbatim, plus veg_dry in exempt_slots: on Friday (north) the south row otherwise had only north dishes to choose from and quietly took one. The two row rules below keep row 1 north and row 2 south on every day.
rules.name: theme_cuisine_filter
rules._indian_veg_dry_comment: The Chinese-day filter does not read exempt_slots: it narrowed Thursday's veg dry to Chinese-style dishes (951 -> 64, south 368 -> 1), so from week 2 the South Veg Dry row had nothing south left and was relaxed (17 Nov, 25-day run). On a Chinese day veg dry stays Indian, north or south.

rules._comment: The second non-veg row exists on Wednesday only; every other day it stays blank.
rules.name: rippling_second_nonveg_wed_only

rules._comment: Row 'NonVeg Main (Chicken)': the first non-veg cell is a chicken dish every day.
rules.name: rippling_chicken_first_row

rules._comment: Row 'NonVeg Main (Egg)': the second non-veg cell, which only Wednesday has, is an egg dish.
rules.name: rippling_egg_second_row

rules._comment: Row 'North Veg Dry' is the first veg dry cell. The city rule veg_dry_north_south_pair only asks for one of each per DAY, in either cell; the rows are labelled, so each cell is bound.
rules.name: rippling_north_veg_dry_first_row

rules._comment: Row 'South Veg Dry' is the second veg dry cell.
rules.name: rippling_south_veg_dry_second_row

rules._comment: curd_side is the RAITA slot: a one-slot composition IS 'this slot must be a raita' (repo_map note 20). The plain-curd station is the separate `curd` slot, whose pool is already plain curd only.
rules.name: rippling_raita_only

rules._comment: Bread 1 is pinned to plain chapati every day below, so it is a staple: exempt from unique_items and the cooldown, else week 2 finds it in history and goes INFEASIBLE (same as DXC). The dish itself, not its sub_category: the whole phulka family let bread 2 repeat ragi phulka and rava onion roti within days (17 Nov).
rules.name: rippling_plain_chapati_repeatable

rules._comment: Bread 2 is never plain chapati, which is bread 1's pinned dish (owner, 17 Nov).
rules.name: rippling_second_bread_not_plain_chapati

rules._comment: T3: 'Cut fruits or any fruit alone can not come in menu.' fresh_fruit is exactly the 11 fruit-alone desserts (cut fruit, papaya/watermelon cuts, whole banana, orange, seasonal fruit); fruit custard, fruit kesari and banana halwa sit in other sub-categories and stay.
rules.name: rippling_no_fruit_alone_dessert

rules._comment: Kootu is a South Veg Dry here, never a Lentil (slot_pool_moves below), and at most once in 8 days: this is the within-week half. A regional day is exempt (owner, 2026-11-17).
rules.name: rippling_kootu_once_a_week

rules._comment: The cross-week half: no kootu within 8 days of a saved one. No base_slot on purpose: a base_slot scopes the family by course_type, and kootu's course_type is dal.
rules.name: rippling_kootu_8_days

rules._comment: Breakfast: the non-veg sandwich is Thursday only (owner, 2026-11-17). Lunch and dinner have no such row, so this is breakfast-only by construction.
rules.name: rippling_breakfast_nonveg_sandwich_thursday

rules._comment: Breakfast: the veg sandwich steps aside on the non-veg sandwich day.
rules.name: rippling_breakfast_veg_sandwich_not_thursday

slot_pool_moves._comment: Kootu out of Lentils, into Veg Dry. It is south Indian, so it lands on the South Veg Dry row.

Rippling._combo_by_theme_comment: Sambar / Rasam is one row (the sambar_rasam combination: rasam three days, sambar two). The biryani day is always rasam, wherever it falls in the plan.

constant_items_by_meal._comment: T1: the make-your-own salad (salad row) and dressings (chutney row, labelled 'Dressing') are fixed per weekday and differ between the lunch and dinner sessions of the one counter. Same every week. bread__1 = plain chapati at lunch and dinner (per session, not client-wide: a client-wide pin is printed at breakfast too, which has no bread row).

breakfast._comment: Breakfast sheet (owner, 2026-11-17): the Eggs row (on the 'side' category) and Accompaniments 2 (the 'condiment' category) are fixed text.
breakfast.condiment: Chat masala, salt pepper, butter (Amul sachets), kissan jam, ketchup packets
